create_project_with_label_config: create a Label Studio project with a label config using ls.projects.create
import_tasks_into_project: import tasks into a Label Studio project using ls.projects.import_tasks
create_ml_backend_for_project: create an ML backend for a Label Studio project using ls.ml.create
run_batch_predictions_via_actions: run batch predictions on tasks via actions using ls.actions.create with retrieve_tasks_predictions
convert_predictions_to_annotations: convert predictions to annotations via actions using ls.actions.create with predictions_to_annotations
list_predictions_in_project: list all predictions in a Label Studio project using ls.predictions.list
list_tasks_in_project: list tasks in a Label Studio project using ls.tasks.list
